note: Mostly seasonal private campground a mile south of Owatonna among oaks on a bend of the Straight River, beside I-35, with a heated pool, mini-golf, playgrounds, kayaking and weekend activities. The campground says, and the map shows, many seasonal and long-term residents, with a block of sites kept for short stays. --Claude
summary: Operator site + 2026 map read: $50 W/E / $55 FHU for two (exactly at the gate - passes), holiday weeks +$10, extra vehicle $5, 6 people max; weekend 2-night and holiday 3-night minimums; books on ResortForward; 30/50 A full hookups, sites to 60 ft, pull-throughs; facilities confirmed. Mostly seasonal by the map (~55 nightly of ~170) but passes the long-stay tests. Closed for the 2026 season (off-season). Waterfront lead: nightly D/C rows along the river under canopy; not waterfront kept. Pin OK. Phone confirmed. Google 4.4/277.
flags: Price gate: cheapest RV night is $50 (water & electric, two people; site (c) 2026). That is AT the US$50 gate, not over (memory: $50 is at the gate and passes). No gateway within 40 km (St. Paul 101 km); not a Good Sam Park (gs false); no member discount posted on the operator's pages (the stored discounts.military true is the Good Sam directory's derived value).

Long-stay (mostly seasonal): the 2026 map colours roughly 105 sites 'Seasonal' (rows S, H, W, P, much of B, E and F) and about 13 'Monthly Full Hookups' (C2-C11 even, E5, F1-F6), against about 40 nightly water-and-electric sites (A2-A14, C1-C9 odd, D1-D23, G1-G4, K1-K6), 10 nightly full-hookup (B1-B5, B7-B11) and 3 no-hookup (A15-A17). Nightly ~53 of ~170 (~30%). Tests: (1) nightly sold online; (2) nightly prices posted; (3) no discouraging wording - a review on the operator's own home page says 'There are many seasonal or long-term residents but enough spaces for short term stays'; (4) ~30% nightly, well above 1 in 10; (5) presence: own site, booking engine, phone, Google 4.4 from 277. Passes; not iffy. Note says mostly seasonal.

WATERFRONT LEAD: stored not waterfront (audited: 'Straight River along east edge screened by a wooded buffer'). The 2026 map draws the nightly D-loop (D1-D23) inside a bend of the Straight River, with D3, D7, D9, D13, D17, D19 and D23 on the riverbank, and C1-C9 along the river's west arm; a review on the operator site says 'Some of the camp sites are along a river where you can wade'. On imagery the river and those rows (around 44.0525,-93.2510) are under a closed canopy, so neither on-water nor a view can be confirmed and the stored value stays (imagery cannot confirm under canopy). A reviewer with site photos of the D-loop could make it riverview or riverfront.
